messages:
Maya P: Hey everyone — first day! quick q: how do I get Figma access and find the product roadmap docs? also curious about the research process for product/design (who runs it, where briefs live). tagging @Sanjay :wave:

Sanjay (Onboarding): Welcome Maya! 🎉 For Figma, go to Okta -> Apps -> Request Access -> 'Design Tools (Figma)'. If it stays pending, DM me and I'll approve manually. Roadmap docs live in Confluence under /product/roadmap — quicklink: https://confluence.redwood.company/product/roadmap. Research docs are in the Design Drive; I'll DM the direct link.

Elena (Design Lead): Hi Maya — I'll invite you to the Figma team and the 'Redwood Product Kit' files in a few mins. Research process summary: we keep briefs in the 'research-playbooks' folder, run study design in Miro, and post findings as a highlight doc. Typical flow: 1) submit a brief in #design-research, 2) schedule screener with Design Ops, 3) run interviews and add notes to the playbook, 4) share synthesis in the quarterly research roundup. Ping me if you want a quick walkthrough.

Jordan (PM): Adding context — Priya runs the roadmap syncs and can give you the why behind current bets. We maintain a single product-roadmap page (Confluence) with quarterly goals; for deeper history check the release notes in /product/releases. If helpful I can do a 30-min intro this afternoon — I'm free at 3:00pm PT.

Priya (PM): Happy to onboard you — I can join the 3pm PT slot. Also posted a short reading list in #product-onboarding: org goals, recent bet memos, and previous roadmap retros.

DevEx Bot: Access request received: 'Figma' submitted by Maya P. Ticket #INC-4921. Estimated approval window: 2 hours.

Maya P: thanks — I tried the Okta flow and it shows "pending". Sanjay, can you approve if it still needs manual sign-off? 3pm PT works for the intro. excited to get into the files 🙂

Sanjay (Onboarding): Approved the Figma request manually and escalated the ticket so you should see an invite shortly. Also DM'ed the Drive link with the research playbook and the Confluence quicklinks.

Elena (Design Lead): Invite sent to your work email. I added you to the research-playbooks folder and dropped a one-pager checklist in #design-research (bullet list: brief template, screener template, consent script, synthesis template).

Maya P: got the Figma invite and Drive link — files are loading. See you all at 3pm. Thanks for the quick help!
